'''T'haley Overseer''' was an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], T'haley Overseer frequently raided the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] in their [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]].<ref name="SWG:TS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempBlackSunSpaceComm.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of T'haley Overseer]]
T'haley Overseer appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> T'haley Overseer was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. T'haley Overseer was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Valarian starfighters in the Tatoo system.<ref name="SWG:TS" />
